provenance: Owner supplied backpack.zip, handheld-portable-radio-walkie-talkie.zip and earth-terra-downloadable-model.zip and requested their integration. Original creator/licence metadata was not included in the supplied archives; original rights are retained. No CC0 or other new licence is claimed for these models/images.

backpack.placement: Port bench, forward of the rowing seat; surface contact sampled from supplied boat geometry.
backpack.conversion: Reduced from approximately 237,000 triangles; rebuilt vertex normals, preserved authored colour/normal/PBR maps, 1K WebP textures.

radio.placement: Face-up on starboard bench, forward of the oar handles. Click opens existing radio controls; R remains available.
radio.conversion: FBX world transforms baked, glTF UV V convention corrected, one combined mesh and 1K base/normal/packed roughness-metal maps.

earth.usage: Supplied colour and cloud maps on the existing geographic sphere so longitude/latitude orientation stays correct. Cloud layer fades during descent. Blender file was not executed.
